modern: The Pythagoreans tell us to look to the heavens in the morning, so that we may be reminded of those bodies which always do the same things and do their work in the same way, and also be reminded of their purity and nakedness. For there is no veil over a star.
original: The Pythagoreans bid us in the morning look to the heavens that we may be reminded of those bodies which continually do the same things and in the same manner perform their work, and also be reminded of their purity and nudity. For there is no veil over a star.
